newsitem.title: UK: Deadline for bids for Germany refinery postponed.
newsitem.headline: Deadline for bids for Germany refinery postponed.

text.p: The deadline for bids for a German refinery in Wilhelmshaven has been postponed after a deal was struck on Friday to extend oil processing at plant until April next year.

Sources familiar with the 190,000 barrel per day BETA refinery said the bidding process is now "expected to be concluded before the end of the year", extending the previous end October deadline for bids.

The decision to extend the crude oil processing deal, which had been due to stop at the end of the year, was made after discussions with several potential buyers who apparently needed more time to study the refinery's economic and technical data, sources said.
The future of the refinery had been in question following a long-standing dispute between the two shareholders of the plant, SA Louis Dreyfus CIE and Holding Tusculum BV.
